mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following is NOT a method used by the NSSO for measuring unemployment in India?
mcq_fix.why: odd wording 'listed status-based framework'; mirror y22e174ef40b

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: agriculture employed roughly half the workforce in 2012, not 20%; also wrong topic: sectoral employment

patterns: Core asked fact: chronic unemployment / major part of the year = Usual (Principal) Status; odd-one-out 'Current Monthly Status' is not an NSSO method.
Definitions of ratios: WPR = employed / total population (APPSC 2023), LFPR = labour force / working-age population.
Headline numbers: NSS 68th CDS 5.6%; PLFS 2017-18 UR 6.1% (45-year high); PLFS as NSO's standard tool (APPSC G2).
Agencies: NSSO/CSO for data (APPSC 2019), Labour Bureau for disputes/QES.
App adds many current-affairs statement items (monthly CWS, AP-vs-India PLFS) and committee detail beyond PYQ depth, but the methodology core matches.
